text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience building and redesigning modern web experiences with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

I’d love to help revamp your cleaning business website into something that feels polished, trustworthy, and easy to navigate for both residential and commercial clients. For a service business like yours, the site should do more than look good — it should quickly communicate your value, support customer confidence, and make it simple for visitors to find services and get in touch.

I recently worked on a home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home, where I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS the marketing team could edit themselves. That project improved the largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s and increased organic traffic by 38% in 3 months. That experience is directly relevant to your goals because it combined design improvement, better performance, and SEO-aware structure.

For your website redesign, I can help with:
- a cleaner, more modern visual design aligned with your brand
- responsive layouts that work smoothly on desktop, tablet, and mobile
- improved site speed and overall performance
- clear service presentation that highlights your cleaning offerings
- SEO-friendly structure and content organization
- practical implementation of any needed plugins or tools

I’m comfortable collaborating closely to understand your brand identity and goals, then turning that into a website that looks professional and is easy to use. I also pay attention to the details that matter for local service businesses, like clear calls to action, trust-building presentation, and a straightforward user journey.

If you’d like, I can help you plan the redesign so the new site feels modern, loads fast, and supports your business goals from day one.
